dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Centrally located on the lateral flank are three prominent 'O' shaped structures with irregular, high-contrast perimeters. The edges exhibit a sharp gradient transition from a deep brown exterior to a light cream interior, with several adjacent 'C' shapes displaying open perimeters oriented toward the posterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid, low-gradient light-colored blobs is concentrated in the anterior-dorsal region and along the lower lateral boundary near the flipper insertion point. These clusters lack internal dark nuclei and exhibit high core pixel intensity relative to the surrounding pelt.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli in the mid-lateral section form a distorted quadrilateral. Connecting the centroids of the three most distinct rings in the upper dorsal area creates an obtuse scalene triangle with the widest angle facing the anterior.
